p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-up, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens up the current official sources, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for product and country, customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): tariffs and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations for products in your country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and outside the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Taxes, International Trade, Country by Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if the platform has been marked by the regulator before entrusting your money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: The page opens in the language of the country: use the translation function of your browser or the « Understand the document » function for the document.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not make customs declarations: a licensed customs agent (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Rules for Nearly Every Country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): Customs, Taxes, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller hands over the goods to the buyer’s carrier, cleared for export.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after this period, the buyer bears the risk and costs.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: seller pays freight and insurance to port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers the goods to the destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for the product in question.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the charges for your country before shipping.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money and does not earn anything on these links: you compare here and then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Worldwide money transfer prices (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash collection in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees visible before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to your mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the amount you receive: fees + exchange rate, a rate worse than the market is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose the way the person receives the cash: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often a document of identity is required, both for sending and receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online or in order to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it is almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, set the real price, comply with the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. Easy start, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (offers "wholesale / suppliers" here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Determine the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Inform your customers of the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trading rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect customer rights: transparent prices including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
